scenario: Admitted 3 nights for pneumonia; policy 2 years old.
rationale: Inpatient hospitalisation >24 hrs is covered; no waiting period issue at 2 years.

scenario: Hospitalised for dengue; policy started 15 days ago.
rationale: Any non-accident illness within the first 30 days is not payable.

scenario: Broke a leg in a road accident; policy is 10 days old.
rationale: Initial 30-day waiting period does not apply to accidental hospitalisation.

scenario: Diabetic for 5 years; admitted for a diabetes complication; policy 12 months old.
rationale: Pre-existing disease covered only after 36 months of continuous cover.

scenario: Cataract surgery; policy 18 months old.
rationale: Cataract needs 24 months of continuous cover.

scenario: Cataract surgery; policy 3 years old.
rationale: Waiting period met, but cataract claims are capped at Rs 40,000 per eye.

scenario: Father, 65, admitted for cardiac care; policy 4 years old.
rationale: Covered, but a 10% co-pay applies as insured is above 60.

scenario: Chose a deluxe room costing above 1% of the sum insured.
rationale: Room rent capped at 1% of SI/day; higher category => proportionate payment.

scenario: Elective cosmetic nose reshaping.
rationale: Cosmetic/plastic surgery excluded unless due to accident, burn or cancer.

scenario: Reconstructive surgery after a burn injury.
rationale: Cosmetic exclusion has an explicit exception for burns.

scenario: Root canal at the dentist; no accident involved.
rationale: Dental treatment excluded unless due to accident requiring hospitalisation.

scenario: Jaw surgery with hospitalisation after a road accident.
rationale: Dental due to accident requiring hospitalisation is covered.

scenario: Admitted one day only for tests; no active treatment given.
rationale: Hospitalisation purely for diagnostics/observation is excluded.

scenario: Cataract done as a day-care procedure (<24 hrs); policy 3 years old.
rationale: Day-care covered and wait met, but the cataract sub-limit still applies.

scenario: Normal delivery; policy 30 months old.
rationale: Maternity covered after 24 months; normal delivery limited to Rs 50,000.

scenario: Delivery; policy 12 months old.
rationale: Maternity expenses need 24 months of continuous cover.

scenario: Ambulance bill of Rs 3,500.
rationale: Road ambulance covered but capped at Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation.

scenario: Inpatient Ayurvedic treatment at a recognised hospital.
rationale: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to the sum insured.

scenario: Rehab for alcohol dependence.
rationale: Treatment for alcoholism / substance abuse is excluded.

scenario: Injury from a suicide attempt.
rationale: Self-inflicted injury / attempted suicide is excluded.

scenario: Cost of new prescription glasses.
rationale: Spectacles, contact lenses and hearing aids are excluded.

scenario: Diagnostic tests 20 days before admission.
rationale: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 30 days before admission.

scenario: Medicines bought 75 days after discharge.
rationale: Post-hospitalisation covered only up to 60 days after discharge.

scenario: Is my surgery covered? (no other details given)
rationale: Calibration rule: with missing facts, the tool must say Unclear, not guess.
